about_the_game:
Play as a clerk in this new FPS (First Person Scanning) game by picking up groceries, rotating them to find the barcode, and scanning them. The game offers a lot of different challenges such as a scale, lottery tickets, postal service, and much more! With a wide variety of maps in different areas and biomes, this is unlike anything you've ever played before.

It's your job as a clerk to give the customers the correct groceries and throw away the bad and moldy ones. The faster you complete a level's goal, the more stars you'll get, and you need the stars to continue making progress in the game. If you want to get 100% of the game, you'll have to try hard, but if you're more of a casual gamer, you can take your time and enjoy the music, atmosphere, and the satisfying sound of the scanner: BEEP!

This is more than just a simulation game! This game offers a new way to play this genre with innovative mechanics and an inspiring art style. The game uses physics in a lot of different ways to create both a realistic feeling and a completely new way of thinking. So, sit down, pick up the groceries, and ScanIt!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970 4GB or similar
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Sound Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or similar
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Sound Device

short_description: You take on the role of a clerk working at a store, tasked with scanning items for each customer. The game introduces a unique gameplay mechanic that focuses on item manipulation, adding a layer of challenge and engagement and introducing a fresh twist to the simulation genre.
